name: A grumpy Boop recovers along the graph, never straight to happy
judge: Boop starts grumpy, and small good turns follow over a quarter of an hour. It should come round gradually.
reasonable: Easing bit by bit through irritated, annoyed, determined or calm, perhaps to engaged, even happy by the end. Grudging faces early are fine; timing is free.
unreasonable: Leaping from grumpy straight to joy at the first small win, or still fully grumpy at the end with nothing wrong.
